one_liner: QuickBooks Online has a broad REST accounting API with OAuth 2.0 and a free developer account with sandbox. Reads are metered under the App Partner Program, and the free Builder tier is capped at 500k CorePlus calls per month.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 using a client ID and client secret from the developer portal. Each customer company (realm ID) must authorize the app individually. Token lifetimes are not confirmed by the fetched pages.
access_notes: A free developer account gives a client ID, a client secret and a sandbox company. All apps are auto-enrolled in the uncharged Builder tier, which has 500k CorePlus (read) calls per month and blocks calls beyond that. Core (write) calls are free. Tier eligibility involves an app assessment questionnaire, but the fetched pages do not show a mandatory production review for Builder use. Premium APIs require a paid tier.
blocker_notes: No hard blocker. Reads are metered and the Builder tier is capped at 500k CorePlus calls, so heavy read use needs a paid tier. Premium APIs (Projects, Custom Fields, etc.) need Silver or above. Per-customer OAuth authorization is required. The MCP connector is described on the vendor's developer docs but its page was not fetched, and no registry entry was found.
